meta.name: impeccable
meta.description: Use when the user wants to design, redesign, shape, critique, audit, polish, clarify, distill, harden, optimize, adapt, animate, colorize, extract, or otherwise improve a frontend interface. Covers websites, landing pages, dashboards, product UI, app shells, components, forms, settings, onboarding, and empty states. Handles UX review, visual hierarchy, information architecture, cognitive load, accessibility, performance, responsive behavior, theming, anti-patterns, typography, fonts, spacing, layout, alignment, color, motion, micro-interactions, UX copy, error states, edge cases, i18n, and reusable design systems or tokens. Also use for bland designs that need to become bolder or more delightful, loud designs that should become quieter, live browser iteration on UI elements, or ambitious visual effects that should feel technically extraordinary. Not for backend-only or non-UI tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页与产品界面打磨得清晰美观
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想让产品界面看起来更专业、更好用
copy.tagline_en: Polish web pages and product UIs into clear, beautiful experiences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your product's interface to look more professional and easier to use

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以资深设计总监的标准对待界面任务：先读取项目背景与既有设计，再执行设计、改版、评论、打磨或动效等动作，产出可直接使用的代码或完整方案。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计、重做或改进网站/App 的前端界面时触发，例如想让落地页更引人注目、审查仪表盘 UX，或要求调整色彩、排版、动效等；也适用于让平淡设计更大胆、让花哨设计更安静。

say.text: 帮我把这个产品落地页设计得更吸引人。
say.note: 会按设计流程产出新版落地页与说明。

say.text: 审查一下当前后台仪表盘的界面，告诉我哪里需要改进。
say.note: 对应评论/审查流程，给出改进点清单。

say.text: 给这个按钮加一段自然的悬停动效，让页面不那么平淡。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude handles any UI task as a senior design director: reads project context and existing design first, then performs design, redesign, critique, polish, motion, etc., delivering production-ready code or full spec.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to design, redo or improve website/app UI (e.g. striking landing page, dashboard UX review, color/type/motion tweaks). Also for bland->bolder or loud->quieter designs.

say_en.text: Help me design this product landing page to be more attractive.
say_en.note: Runs the design workflow and returns a new page.

say_en.text: Review the current dashboard UI and tell me what to improve.
say_en.note: Maps to critique/audit, lists improvement points.

say_en.text: Add a natural hover micro-interaction to this button so the page is less flat.
